sentences.text: This computational study addresses the gap in existing models that assume a fixed brain network structure rather than treating the network as an unknown variable to be discovered. The researchers developed a new mathematical framework that infers a specific graph or current flow linking where a stimulus starts to where a reaction occurs. The proposed model uses a specific type of optimal transport problem where the cost function encourages the formation of aggregated and branching pathways.

The authors mathematically proved that solutions exist for both discrete and continuous versions of their model and added a new stochastic extension that combines branching transport with path-based control costs. The main finding is that this method offers a way to discover how signals travel through the brain, instead of just controlling signals on a pre-defined path.
